scope: Neutral mobile Kv1.5 proteins carrying four joint m/h conformations on fixed resolved ionic surfaces, alongside conserved leak and Na/K ATPase populations. Two channel populations on unequal patches, finite exterior and maintained bath, plus open/closed two-cell stages. Synthetic 0.4-ms accelerated-diffusion controls at 298.15 K, using a 6.25-us production step. Gate rate-bias work is an explicit phenomenological bookkeeping source, not calibrated heat, ATP use or resolved gating charge. This qualifies numerical composition, not physiological rates or native BETSE redistribution correspondence.
checks: Four positive joint m/h conformation inventories move conservatively; conducting amount is N[m1h1], never the product of averaged gates. At each RK4 stage, current open density and independent channel controls determine potassium permeability and the resolved field. Empty/blocked/zero-permeability channels reduce to the existing pump model.

Independent 80-digit Kv1.5 kinetics and four-state generator/matrix exponential at three voltages test correlated and factorized populations. Marginals reduce to the existing m/h law; mixing may generate correlations. All 27 stage derivatives and potentials are compared to separately accumulated transport, Decimal ATPase/ion laws and a full-node solve, including open/closed two-cell and absent-population cases.

Separate channel conformation, per-cell total material, lateral transfer and gate-transition ledgers. Ideal-mixture energy plus lateral and gate dissipation minus signed rate-bias work closes independently from ionic, ATP and electrode energy. This is phenomenological accounting, with no measured gating heat or thermodynamic calibration claimed. Strict finite/domain rejection; no clipping or logarithm floors.

Five complete trajectories against independent segmented DOP853: mobile, immobile, conduction-blocked, correlated conformation counterflow with frozen gates, and scheduled release. Analytic total-protein diffusion and frozen conformation diffusion, nonzero channel/voltage coupling, NumPy RK4 refinement at 12.5/6.25/3.125 us and tightened-reference checks at unchanged tolerances.

Channel-only schedule boundaries enter the ordinary grid. Compiled negative-control and inventory rejection retains every input field. All 27 state fields survive saved/fresh-process/terminal restart, a future conduction-blocking branch, changed windows and reordered independent worlds with distinct clocks. Blocking does not freeze gates or protein motion.

CPU/L4 comparison covers complete histories and observations with separate Coulomb, ampere and voltage budgets; compiled operations assert actual backend placement. Independent references and NumPy calculations remain on the CPU in both phases.

Existing frozen-source runner and retained failures under 4-GiB worker and 8-GiB host-reserve guards. Contracts, trajectories, replay and independent worlds run in sequential processes. Replay preparation exits before the fresh CLI starts; the coordinator then compares complete history, final state, layout and clock. GPU busy and SM-active recorded without a performance gate. No automatic follow-up.
scope_exclusions: Only the existing Kv1.5 law at 298.15 K in its declared voltage domain. No other mobile channel family or calcium/ER/injury/assembly coupling.
Neutral cargo and fixed geometry. No gating-charge displacement, charged-cargo field feedback, active trafficking, fluid flow, synthesis/degradation or changing geometry.
Maintained ATP/ADP/Pi plus a declared phenomenological gate-rate source; no finite metabolism, calibrated gating energy or autonomous thermodynamic closure.
No native BETSE redistribution trajectory correspondence; its missing helper remains unresolved. No biological diffusion-rate fit or independent wetlab validation.
Independent-world batches only; no distributed single-tissue or measured multi-GPU scaling.
